From: Lydia Chan <procurement@greentech.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II coverage and interim acceptance matrix

Hi Sergio and Marissa,

We're preparing the Q3 renewal packet for GreenTech and need to confirm a couple of items before Procurement can route the PO:

1) Latest SOC 2 Type II report: please confirm the reporting period (start/end dates) and provide the PDF we can attach to the PO.
2) If the Type II period does not cover our renewal effective date (2028-01-01), do you provide a bridge/interim attestation? If so, can you attach the bridge letter and confirm the bridge coverage window and scope? We need language that procurement and our compliance team can accept.
3) To move the PO through our internal controls faster, can you complete the procurement acceptance matrix (see attached template) noting any residual controls or exclusions?

Our target: finalize evidence and get the PO approved by 2027-07-05 to meet our internal fiscal cycle. Please let me know if that timeline is feasible and who on your side will be the canonical contact for final signatures.

Thanks,
Lydia Chan
Sr. Procurement Manager
GreenTech Systems

Attachments: procurement-acceptance-matrix.xlsx (template)

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Lydia Chan <procurement@greentech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II coverage and interim acceptance matrix

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary and next steps below; full attachments included.

Summary:
- Latest SOC 2 Type II (Type II report) covers period 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31. Attached PDF: SOC2-TypeII-Report-20270331.pdf (we've redacted customer-specific appendices per policy).
- We provide a formal bridge letter that extends assurance coverage for procurement purposes until the next Type II completes. Attached: SOC2-TypeII-Bridge-GreenTech-202706.pdf. Bridge window: 2027-04-01 through 2028-01-15. Scope: Production inference service endpoints, data processing controls, encryption-in-transit and at-rest; excludes customer-managed on-prem connectors (call-out in paragraph 3).
- Procurement acceptance matrix: completed our side and attached as procurement-acceptance-matrix.xlsx. Key rows noted where procurement typically raises questions (data retention, subprocessor list, audit rights).

Action items / timeline:
- We need your review and sign-off on the bridge letter language and the completed matrix. If approved, Ben (cc'd) will countersign and we can provide a DocuSign link.
- If DocuSign is acceptable, Ben can initiate same-day; otherwise we can return a signed PDF within two business days.
- We confirm the bridge is intentionally conservative through 2028-01-15 to give both parties runway for audit scheduling. If GreenTech needs coverage to 2028-03-31, we can discuss an extension but would need to align with our Q1 audit plan.

Notes for your compliance team:
- Audit scope: includes production inference and control plane for hosted customers (Redwood Hosted). It excludes any Dedicated or Private deployment controls specific to customer-managed infrastructure.
- Evidence package: we can provide control narratives for encryption key management and change control artifacts on request.

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Bridge-GreenTech-202706.pdf, redwood-interim-attestation-202706.docx, procurement-acceptance-matrix.xlsx

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0163

Thanks Sergio — that's helpful and fast. A couple clarifying points from our side: 

- The bridge window through 2028-01-15 should be fine for our renewal timing, but Compliance asked whether the bridge explicitly references acceptance of the redaction policy you mentioned. They want a one-line affirmation that the bridge covers the standard redacted report we provided (i.e., customer appendices redacted). Can you add that sentence or confirm that the attached bridge letter already includes it?

- Can you confirm whether the scope exclusion for Dedicated/Private deployments affects any of GreenTech's use? We're on Hosted today, but exploring a Private deployment in 2028; we need to ensure the bridge doesn't create surprise gaps if we move workloads.

- Procurement prefers DocuSign for signatures. Can Ben start the envelope once you confirm language?

Assuming the above is straightforward, we'll aim to get the PO routed by 2027-07-02 and sign by 2027-07-05.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I will route to Compliance and AP this afternoon.

Best,
Lydia
